gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Snowburst One is a stencil cutout with wide bridges and a tall lowercase. Noto Sans Tai Le follows with ink strokes that taper out before touching, so paragraphs of text move along without any fuss.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-th: Noto Sans Tai Tham reads chalkboard-simple, its lowercase crowding the capital line. Snowburst One, stencil-cut and tall, takes the loud role up top, while the body quietly does the reading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri leaves each small round letter generously unclosed. Noto Sans Takri is best at quiet text, while Snowburst One, with its tall stencil lowercase, is best at making noise.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads with round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Snowburst One brings stencil bridges and bold, loud punch up top.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Stencil punch up front: Snowburst One brings wide bridges between letters. Noto Sans Tangsa takes over for reading, its wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems easing the eye along.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tifina: Noto Sans Tifinagh reads soft and inviting, its rounded lowercase bowls swelling like inflated shapes. Yet Snowburst One, cut like a stencil and tall in the lowercase, supplies the bold jolt up top.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-numans: Snowburst One is a bold stencil, tall in the lowercase, with wide bridges between letters. Numans pushes its spacing well past normal, so running text drifts by loose, relaxed and unhurried.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-oxygen: Expressive is the right word for Snowburst One, a stencil cutout with wide bridges and a tall lowercase. And Oxygen, with curves that never close back on themselves, gives that loud heading quiet company.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-puritan: Puritan keeps its rounded forms clearly open to the side, with oversized e and a counters that make text easy going. Snowburst One does the shouting, all stencil bridges and tall, bold letters.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-aldrich: Pipe-cleaner strokes and open curves: Tektur is built from outsized proportions. Aldrich keeps its lowercase close to cap height and its round letters cupped, so running text feels like tracing one thick thread.
